description: Complete IndustriConnect BACnet MCP tool corpus as Morgana Scripts. 7 source-faithful tools mapped one-to-one from the pinned IndustriAgents IndustriConnect MCP server. Executes against mock devices or explicitly authorized industrial endpoints via the generic MCP stdio runner.
author: IndustriAgents (converted by X3M.AI for Morgana)
capabilities: Provides the complete BACnet MCP tool corpus (7 tools).
Read/observe, write/modify, and control operations classified by operational risk.
Runs through the generic morgana_mcp_stdio_runner asset against the pinned MCP server.
use_cases: Authorized OT/ICS lab assessment using IndustriConnect mock devices.
Detection validation for industrial protocol operations.
Purple Team validation against simulated industrial processes.
prerequisites: Morgana Agent enabled as an Industrial Lab Host with Python 3.10+ and uv installed.
Pinned IndustriConnect runtime tree installed on the Lab Host (see Industrial Lab).
An explicitly authorized mock device, simulator, or approved production test target.
safety_notes: Write and control tools alter device/process state; Morgana requires explicit operator confirmation for modify/disrupt content.
Never target production OT/ICS systems without written authorization and an agreed rollback plan.
Raw-socket protocols (EtherCAT, PROFINET) require dedicated network interfaces and Layer-2 access.

scripts.name: INDUSTRICONNECT - BACnet - Ping / Connection Status
scripts.description: IndustriConnect BACnet MCP tool 'ping'. Return MCP server health and target connection status.
scripts.command:
import importlib.util as _iu, json as _j, os as _o, sys as _s
_spec=_iu.spec_from_file_location('_mrm', r'{{asset:industriconnect_mcp_runner}}')
_m=_iu.module_from_spec(_spec);_spec.loader.exec_module(_m)
_env=dict(_o.environ)
_env['BACNET_INTERFACE']=str('#{ic_bacnet_interface}'.strip())
_env['BACNET_PORT']=str('#{ic_bacnet_port}'.strip())
_env['BACNET_DEVICE_INSTANCE']=str('#{ic_bacnet_device_instance}'.strip())
_env['BACNET_WRITES_ENABLED']=str('#{ic_bacnet_writes_enabled}'.strip())
_env['PYTHONUNBUFFERED']='1'
_env['PYTHONIOENCODING']='utf-8'
_args={}
_out=_m.run_mcp_tool(command=['uv', 'run', 'bacnet-mcp'],cwd=_o.path.join(r'#{ic_runtime_dir}'.strip(), 'BACnet-Project', 'bacnet-python'),tool_name='ping',arguments=_args,env=_env,timeout=60.0)
print('MORGANA_RESULT '+_j.dumps(_out))
